interaction: Pick a lash style (natural, classic, hybrid, volume, cat-eye) and a brow shape (soft arch, straight, lifted, optional tint) and the single-line eye drawing is procedurally redrawn: lash count, length, curl and direction morph along the lid and the brow outline and brushed-up hairs reshape, while a result line gives the combined time and a sample price. 'Add to booking' carries the look into the appointment request form, which ends in a demo-only message.
notes: Line art is stylised, not a visual promise of results; times and prices are samples.
